basic_details.job_title: CSL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 26 Production & Commissioning Engineer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) has released its Production & Commissioning Recruitment 2026 notification, inviting online applications from Ex-Indian Navy and Ex-Indian Coast Guard Personnel for 26 posts on contract basis. The recruitment covers Production & Commissioning Engineers (Mechanical and Electrical) and Production & Commissioning Assistants (Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics/Instrumentation & Controls). This CSL Recruitment 2026 drive is intended specifically for candidates with relevant marine engineering background gained during naval or coast guard service. Register for Job Alerts

Go through the User Manual and FAQ published on the portal before filling the application.
Complete the One Time Registration on the SAP Online portal.
Fill in the application form and upload certificates for proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste (if applicable), and a recent passport-size colour photograph.
Pay the applicable application fee online using Debit Card, Credit Card, or Internet Banking.
Review all entries carefully, since changes cannot be made after final submission, and submit the application.

content_sections.heading: CSL Production & Commissioning Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) has released its Production & Commissioning Recruitment 2026 notification, inviting online applications from Ex-Indian Navy and Ex-Indian Coast Guard Personnel for 26 posts on contract basis. The recruitment covers Production & Commissioning Engineers (Mechanical and Electrical) and Production & Commissioning Assistants (Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics/Instrumentation & Controls). This CSL Recruitment 2026 drive is intended specifically for candidates with relevant marine engineering background gained during naval or coast guard service. Register for Job Alerts

rows.details: Maximum 5 years, subject to project requirements and performance

content_sections.heading: CSL Production & Commissioning Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates planning to apply should note the CSL Recruitment 2026 application window carefully, as the SAP portal will not accept submissions after the deadline. Candidates are advised in the official notification to submit their applications well in advance of the last date, since troubleshooting or technical support will not be available after 1600 hrs on 04 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: CSL Production & Commissioning Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 26 vacancies have been notified across five posts under this CSL Vacancy 2026 drive. The number of vacancies indicated is based on current requirement and may vary depending on future project needs. CSL reserves the right to increase, decrease, or cancel any of the notified vacancies as per its requirement. The role involves frequent visits to work sites, docks, and ships under construction or repair, and has not been identified as suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) due to safety considerations.

content_sections.heading: CSL Production & Commissioning Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for CSL Recruitment 2026 is restricted to a specific candidate category, along with post-wise qualification and experience requirements. Only Ex-Indian Navy and Ex-Indian Coast Guard Personnel are eligible to apply for these posts. Candidates currently working as Production & Commissioning Engineers or Assistants on the rolls of CSL as on the date of this notification are not eligible. The qualification must be from a University, Institute, or Examination Board recognized by AICTE or an appropriate statutory authority / State or Central Government. Candidates with equivalent qualifications must submit an Equivalency Certificate issued by the competent authority, failing which their candidature will not be considered. Post-qualification experience is reckoned as on 04 September 2026, and only experience gained after passing the stipulated qualification is counted. The upper age limit for all posts is 58 years as on 04 September 2026, meaning applicants must be born on or after 05 September 1968. No relaxation details are specified in the provided notification. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: CSL Production & Commissioning Selection Process
content_sections.text: The CSL Recruitment 2026 selection process is conducted out of 100 marks at CSL, Kochi. Based on the number of applications received, CSL may shortlist candidates by scrutinising eligibility through the certificates uploaded during application. Only shortlisted candidates are permitted to attend the selection process, and original certificates with self-attested copies must be produced at the time of Certificate Verification. A rank list is prepared based on marks secured in the selection process. If two or more candidates secure the same marks, relative merit is decided based on seniority in age. The rank list remains valid for up to 18 months from the date of reporting of the last candidate, or until a fresh notification for the same post is issued.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSL Production & Commissioning Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply online; no other mode of application is accepted. Visit the official website www.cochinshipyard.in and go to the Career page → CSL, Kochi. Go through the User Manual and FAQ published on the portal before filling the application. Complete the One Time Registration on the SAP Online portal. Fill in the application form and upload certificates for proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste (if applicable), and a recent passport-size colour photograph. Pay the applicable application fee online using Debit Card, Credit Card, or Internet Banking. Review all entries carefully, since changes cannot be made after final submission, and submit the application. Ensure the application status shows "In Process" after submission, and retain a soft copy or printout containing the unique registration number for future reference. Applicants should not submit more than one application, and applications in draft or withdrawn status will not be considered. Printouts, certificates, or fee payment proof should not be sent by post to CSL. The online application link will remain active on www.cochinshipyard.in from 17 August 2026 to 04 September 2026. Applicants are advised to apply well before the last date to avoid heavy website traffic near the deadline.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSL Production & Commissioning Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Cochin Shipyard Limited to fill 26 contract-basis posts of Production & Commissioning Engineers and Assistants, open only to Ex-Indian Navy and Ex-Indian Coast Guard Personnel.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 26 vacancies are notified across five posts: Engineer (Mechanical) – 8, Engineer (Electrical) – 6, Assistant (Mechanical) – 4, Assistant (Electrical) – 7, and Assistant (Electronics/Instrumentation & Controls) – 1.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for online application submission is 04 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Engineer posts require a Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering; Assistant posts require X Std. (10th pass). All posts additionally require a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant marine discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 58 years as on 04 September 2026, i.e., applicants must be born on or after 05 September 1968.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹300/- (non-refundable, plus bank charges extra). SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the SAP portal accessible via www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CSL, Kochi) between 17 August 2026 and 04 September 2026.
